accessPoints.name: Blue Creek (Cowlitz Trout Hatchery)
accessPoints.note: Tacoma Power explicitly confirms free public river access, a boat launch and parking. WDFW publishes this coordinate for the adjacent ADA fishing platforms and explicitly distinguishes those platforms from the Tacoma Power ramp. The agency aerial photo and individual satellite image identify the same hatchery-side facility. This is an approximate access area, not an exact ramp or a choice between unverified nearby ramps.

accessPoints.name: Sultan Sportsman Park
accessPoints.note: The city facility page confirms river access and publishes this park coordinate. City Ordinance 1430-26 separately identifies the parking area and boat launch and prohibits overnight parking. Imagery confirms the park northeast of the confluence. Exact shoreline access under the bridges and trees remains unverified; do not substitute the industrial property across the Sultan River.

accessPoints.name: Howard Miller Steelhead Park
accessPoints.note: The current county directory confirms river access. County Topographic Atlas 2011 page 49 labels Howard Miller Boat Launch here, and the county’s September 2011 kiosk notice independently names this launch. The existing research candidate projects to UTM 10N 603813 E, 5371106 N, matching the atlas launch vicinity; imagery shows the river-side lot west of SR 530. Trees obscure the precise ramp end. Retain Area precision and do not claim a current fee from the old proposed fee schedule.

accessPoints.name: Kanaskat-Palmer State Park
accessPoints.note: State Parks explicitly permits hand launching and maps separate upper and lower put-in/take-out sites. The earlier research coordinate matches the upper day-use parking loop and river bend in individual imagery and the agency map. No agency shoreline coordinate is claimed. Class IV water lies downstream of the upper site; the park map says expert boaters only beyond that point. The 2026–27 winter schedule lists day use open, with possible severe-weather closures.

accessPoints.name: Flaming Geyser State Park
accessPoints.note: The current State Parks page and brochure describe kayaking on the park’s Green River frontage. The candidate matches the eastern picnic-area parking loop, shelters and lodge on the agency brochure and individual imagery, about 100 m inland. Several shoreline entries exist, and none is promoted as an exact landing. The 2026–27 schedule lists day use open but warns of periodic winter closures. This does not assert a developed boat ramp.

accessPoints.name: Waterfront Park (Leavenworth)
accessPoints.note: The city invites floating at Waterfront Park, and its public facility listing identifies the Beach Area at 997 Main Street. Individual imagery matches the existing research candidate to the wooded park between Main Street parking and the Wenatchee. No single beach is selected as an exact launch. City hours are 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; restrooms close for winter around October 15. This downstream Class II–III section is distinct from the city’s gentler upstream river-shuttle float.
